items.heading: Doubles
details: Key ingredients: fried flatbread, curried chickpeas, chutney
Make a soft, slightly spiced flatbread dough and fry small rounds until puffed.
Simmer chickpeas in a light curry sauce.
Sandwich the curried chickpeas between two fried breads.
Top with tamarind or pepper chutney before serving.

items.heading: Pelau
details: Key ingredients: rice, pigeon peas, chicken, coconut milk, caramelized sugar
Caramelize sugar in a large pot until deep brown.
Brown chicken pieces in the caramelized sugar.
Add pigeon peas, coconut milk and rice.
Simmer covered until the rice is tender and richly colored.

items.heading: Roti
details: Ingredients: flour, water, salt and fat; yeast or leavening when required.
Mix into a soft dough, rest, shape or roll, then cook on a hot griddle or bake until cooked and lightly browned.

items.heading: Callaloo
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
